title: 萌啦 OZON 数据授权
description: 使用萌啦访问令牌连接 OZON 市场数据服务。令牌仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 下，不会上传云端。
description_en: Connect to the OZON market data service with a Menglar access token. Tokens are stored locally in ~/.workbuddy only and are never uploaded to the cloud.

fields.label: 访问令牌
fields.description: 萌啦 OZON 访问令牌，用于认证 MCP 请求。将以 Authorization 请求头形式注入。
fields.description_en: Menglar OZON access token used to authenticate MCP requests. It will be injected as the Authorization request header.
